channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Blake Griffin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Blake Griffin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Blake Griffin
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan:

“Blake Griffin is one of the most, I don't think he gets the credit that he deserves, bro. The way his game was able to adapt over the course of his career was amazing. When he first came in, he was obviously a highlight reel dunker and playmaker.”

DeAndre Jordan on Blake Griffin, Jun 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Blake Griffin:

“If someone who has a hall of fame resume who can buy in and just be that selfless, it carries throughout the entire team.”

Jayson Tatum on Blake Griffin, Mar 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Rivers on Blake Griffin:

“It's unusual that a star like him is willing to turn himself into a role player ... most can't ... when I went to LA, I realized his passing. We started used him at the elbow more ... bring the ball up. We opened his game up quite a bit.”

Doc Rivers on Blake Griffin, Oct 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Marcus Smart on Blake Griffin:

“Love it... He’s not above the rim anymore, but he still does great things... Lastyear he led the league in charges taken. For a guy that doesn’t play as much, that speaks volumes... It’s a great vet for some of these young guys to listen to.”

Marcus Smart on Blake Griffin, Oct 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas
item.description:
Mike Singer:Austin Rivers on his IG live right now:

“You should've seen the Nets team that we were playing tonight. Patty Mills, Blake Griffin, Cam Thomas were the only ones we knew.”

Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas, Dec 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Steve Nash on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Steve Nash says,

“I have a lot of confidence in Blake (Griffin) — He’s just a veteran player that’s finding his rhythm, that’s not uncommon.”

Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, Nov 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @ajayibrowne.

item.title: Sean Marks on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets GMSean Marks on re-signing Blake Griffin in free agency:

“I think we would love him back. That is certainly the plan. There's no secret about that.”

Sean Marks on Blake Griffin, Aug 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsJerami Grant on difference after Griffin/Rose left:

“I think the young guys did a great job of stepping up and doing what they needed to do, on both ends.”

Jerami Grant on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Apr 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on outside reaction to the #Nets adding Griffin and Aldridge:

“I don’t know what we’re supposed to do: Stand pat and not try to improve?... That’s the idea of this league, is to try to get better.”

Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Nash on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on the idea of Blake Griffin starting:

“Anything’s possible.... I think a lot of that has yet to play out.”

Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Blake Griffin, James Harden
item.description:
“No players want to come to the Knicks. Think about the last four guys who came to New York — they’re all in Brooklyn. They landed in New York and went to Brooklyn. KD, Kyrie, James Harden, Blake Griffin,”

Charles Oakley on Blake Griffin, James Harden, Mar 13, 2021. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: James Harden on Blake Griffin
item.description:
James Harden on Blake Griffin:

“We haven’t acquired anybody yet, so I can answer that later if it happens, but we all know how exciting Blake Griffin is and the player he is.”

James Harden on Blake Griffin, Mar 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Mason Plumlee on the void left by Derrick Rose and Blake Griffin:

“As far as leadership, they were great, especially with the young guys.”

Mason Plumlee on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Derrick Rose:

“Derrick is a pro's pro. Like Blake Griffin, he's going to be in the Hall of Fame someday.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Feb 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Blake Griffin
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on ripple effect of Blake Griffin being out:

“We're going to look at a lot of different situations and lineups. It should be increased minutes for Svi, Sekou and Saddiq.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Blake Griffin, Feb 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on how Blake Griffin should be remembered:

“He gave his heart and soul for us to get to the playoffs my first year.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Feb 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin:

“He's still part of us right now. His track record, playing resume, speaks for itself. Some day the guy is going to be a Hall of Famer.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Feb 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
James Edwards III:Saddiq on Blake Griffin:

“For someone to be on this team with that amount of knowledge, I had no choice but to ask certain things, how to be prepared.”

Saddiq Bey on Blake Griffin, Feb 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin's impact:

“It's Blake's presence with the team and presence on the floor and things he does in terms of quarterbacking. Once he gets his rhythm, I can see (his production) coming around.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Jan 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Christian Wood on Blake Griffin, Andre Drummond
item.description:
After the All-Star break, Wood took it to another level, averaging 24.0 points, 9.6 rebounds and 1.0 block per game before the pandemic ended the Pistons’ season on March 11.Wood credits Casey for his breakthrough season.

“He’s always trusted me. I was always playing behind Andre Drummond and Blake Griffin at the time. But [Casey] would say, ‘This kid is talented. We just got to give him an opportunity in the system and get him right.’ And that’s what he did,”

Christian Wood on Blake Griffin, Andre Drummond, Jan 6, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on handling Blake Griffin and Derrick Rose in preseason:

“We're not in a position to rest; we've been off for nine months.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Saddiq Bey on working out with Blake Griffin:

“It was a blessing how everything ended up ... we had a good relationship and he said I could come out to LA and work out with him.”

Saddiq Bey on Blake Griffin, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
#Pistons Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin's return:

“Blake was in last week and he looked good. His body looked great ... He was moving well on the court and had some bounce. That was exciting for me to see and everyone to see where he in his rehab process for the summer.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Aug 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#Pistons GMTroy Weaver on the roster:

“You have two veteran, big-time players looking to restore their careers (Griffin and Rose). Both guys have had some injury history and looking forward to building their careers back. We're excited to get them healthy.”

Troy Weaver on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Jun 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Chris Paul on Blake Griffin
item.description:
“I think about it at times. And me and Blake Griffin absolutely had our issues here and there, but I actually appreciated Blake probably a lot more after I left.”

Chris Paul on Blake Griffin, Apr 3, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Rick Pitino
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Blake Griffin's injury:

“It's like when Rick Pitino said, 'Larry Bird isn't walking through that door.' ... Blake Griffin isn't walking through that door.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Rick Pitino, Jan 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Blake Griffin's potential return:

“He’s been pestering everybody. I can’t wait to get him out there– hopefully it’s tonight. We’ll find out.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin
item.description:
#Pistons Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin's knee injury:

“People say it’s a ruse or whatever, but it’s real. His body will let him know if he can go or not. It’s not like we are trying to play without him.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Luke Kennard on Blake Griffin
item.description:
Kennard recognizes that when there are more shooters to space the floor for the team, they will have more chances to succeed.

“When we have Blake Griffin in the post, he gets two or even guys on him,”

Luke Kennard on Blake Griffin, Mar 13, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.
